```{r setup2, include=FALSE}
spec_df <- params$stats$spec_df
safe_id <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x <- gsub('\\s*\\(.*\\)$', '', x)
  x <- gsub('[^A-Za-z0-9]', '', x)
  tolower(x)
}
safe_num <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(x)))
norm_path <- function(p) {
  p <- as.character(p)
  p[is.na(p)] <- ''
  tryCatch(normalizePath(p, winslash = '/', mustWork = FALSE), error = function(e) p)
}
find_logo <- function(fname) {
  cand <- c(
    system.file('figures', fname, package = 'forplotR'),
    file.path('figures', fname),
    file.path(getwd(), 'figures', fname)
  )
  cand <- norm_path(cand)
  cand <- cand[nzchar(cand) & file.exists(cand)]
  if (length(cand)) cand[1] else ''
}
```

```{r logo, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
forplotr_logo_path <- find_logo('forplotR_hex_sticker.png')
forestplots_logo_path <- find_logo('forestplotsnet_logo.png')
monitora_logo_path <- find_logo('monitora_logo.png')

raw_it <- if (!is.null(params$input_type)) {
  params$input_type
} else if (!is.null(params$metadata$input_type)) {
  params$metadata$input_type
} else {
  ''
}

input_type <- tolower(trimws(as.character(raw_it)))
lang <- if (!is.null(params$language)) tolower(trimws(as.character(params$language))) else ''
is_monitora <- identical(input_type, 'monitora')
is_pa <- identical(input_type, 'field_sheet_ti')
show_partner_logo <- !is_pa

pa_logo_paths <- c(
  find_logo('jbrj.png'),
  find_logo('iakio.png'),
  find_logo('ci.png'),
  find_logo('isa.png')
)

pa_logo_hrefs <- c(
  'https://www.gov.br/jbrj/pt-br',
  'https://www.instagram.com/associacao.iakio/#',
  'https://brasil.conservation.org/',
  'https://www.socioambiental.org/'
)

partner_logo_path <- if (is_monitora) monitora_logo_path else forestplots_logo_path
partner_href <- if (is_monitora) {
  'https://www.gov.br/icmbio/pt-br/assuntos/monitoramento/programa-monitora'
} else {
  'https://forestplots.net'
}
partner_width <- if (is_monitora) '0.24\\linewidth' else '0.32\\linewidth'

if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {
  cat('\\vspace{0.6cm}\n')
  cat('\\begin{center}\n')

  if (nzchar(forplotr_logo_path) && file.exists(forplotr_logo_path)) {
    cat(sprintf(
      '\\href{https://dboslab.github.io/forplotR-website/}{\\includegraphics[width=0.18\\linewidth]{%s}}',
      forplotr_logo_path
    ), '\n')
  } else {
    cat('{\\Large\\textbf{forplotR}}\n')
  }

  cat('\\vspace{0.25cm}\n')
  cat('\\begin{minipage}{\\textwidth}\\centering\n')

  if (show_partner_logo && nzchar(partner_logo_path) && file.exists(partner_logo_path)) {
    cat(sprintf(
      '\\href{%s}{\\includegraphics[width=%s,keepaspectratio]{%s}}',
      partner_href, partner_width, partner_logo_path
    ), '\n')
  } else if (show_partner_logo) {
    cat(sprintf('{\\large %s}\n',
      if (is_monitora) 'MONITORA Program' else 'ForestPlots.net'))
  }

  if (is_pa && length(pa_logo_paths) > 0) {
    cat('\\vspace{0.25cm}\n')
    for (i in seq_along(pa_logo_paths)) {
      if (nzchar(pa_logo_paths[i]) && file.exists(pa_logo_paths[i])) {
        cat(sprintf(
          '\\href{%s}{\\includegraphics[width=0.14\\linewidth,keepaspectratio]{%s}}',
          pa_logo_hrefs[i], pa_logo_paths[i]
        ))
        if (i < length(pa_logo_paths)) cat('\\hspace{0.25cm}\n')
      }
    }
    cat('\n')
  }

  cat('\\end{minipage}\n')
  cat('\\end{center}\n')

} else if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  cat('<div style="text-align:center; margin-top:1rem; margin-bottom:1rem;">\n')

  if (nzchar(forplotr_logo_path) && file.exists(forplotr_logo_path)) {
    cat(sprintf(
      '<a href="https://dboslab.github.io/forplotR-website/"><img src="%s" style="width:140px; margin-bottom:0.6rem;"></a><br/>',
      forplotr_logo_path
    ))
  } else {
    cat('<div style="font-size:1.6rem; font-weight:bold; margin-bottom:0.6rem;">forplotR</div>\n')
  }

  cat('<div style="margin-top:0.2rem;">\n')

  if (show_partner_logo && nzchar(partner_logo_path) && file.exists(partner_logo_path)) {
    cat(sprintf(
      '<a href="%s"><img src="%s" style="width:180px; margin:0.3rem 0.6rem; vertical-align:middle;"></a>',
      partner_href, partner_logo_path
    ))
  } else if (show_partner_logo) {
    cat(sprintf('<span style="font-size:1.1rem; margin:0 0.8rem;">%s</span>',
      if (is_monitora) 'MONITORA Program' else 'ForestPlots.net'))
  }

  if (is_pa && length(pa_logo_paths) > 0) {
    cat('<div style="margin-top:0.5rem;">\n')
    for (i in seq_along(pa_logo_paths)) {
      if (nzchar(pa_logo_paths[i]) && file.exists(pa_logo_paths[i])) {
        cat(sprintf(
          '<a href="%s"><img src="%s" style="width:95px; margin:0.2rem 0.4rem; vertical-align:middle;"></a>',
          pa_logo_hrefs[i], pa_logo_paths[i]
        ))
      }
    }
    cat('</div>\n')
  }

  cat('</div>\n')
  cat('</div>\n')
}
```

```{r all-tag-anchors, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
t2s_df <- params$tag_to_subplot
if (!is.null(t2s_df) && nrow(t2s_df) > 0) {
  tag_vec <- as.character(t2s_df$`New Tag No`)
  tag_vec <- trimws(tag_vec)
  tag_vec <- tag_vec[!is.na(tag_vec) & nzchar(tag_vec)]
  subplot_vec <- t2s_df$T1[match(tag_vec, t2s_df$`New Tag No`)]
  ids <- sprintf('tag-%s-S%s', tag_vec, subplot_vec)
  ids <- unique(ids)
  if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {
    for (id in ids) cat(sprintf('\\hypertarget{%s}{}', id), '\n')
  } else if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
    for (id in ids) cat(sprintf('<div id="%s"></div>', id), '\n')
  }
}
```

```{r meta-census, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
  cat(paste0('**Dead trees since first census:** ', n_dead, '\n\n'))
}
n_rec <- params$stats$recruits_since_first
if (length(n_rec) == 1L && is.finite(n_rec)) {
  cat(paste0('**Recruits since first census:** ', n_rec, '\n\n'))
}
```

## Índice da Subparcela {#subplot-index}

```{r toc, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
cols <- 5
n <- length(params$subplots_list)
per_col <- ceiling(n / cols)

# Get translations inside the chunk
lang <- params$language
subplots_label <- switch(lang,
  'pt' = 'Subparcelas',
  'es' = 'Subparcelas',
  'fr' = 'Sous-parcelles',
  'ma' = '子样地',
  'pa' = 'Rêtâ kukâra krepãã sââ',
  'Subplots'
)

# Create header with proper Markdown table format
header_cells <- rep(subplots_label, cols)
header <- paste(header_cells, collapse = ' | ')

# Separator line (must use only dashes and pipes, no translated text)
separator <- paste(rep(':---', cols), collapse = ' | ')

toc_lines <- c(header, separator)

# Create subplot links with translated prefix
subplot_prefix <- switch(lang,
  'pt' = 'Subparcela ',
  'es' = 'Subparcela ',
  'fr' = 'Sous-parcelle ',
  'ma' = '子样地 ',
  'pa' = 'Rêtâ kukâra krepãã sââ ',
  'Subplot '
)

for (i in seq_len(per_col)) {
  row <- character(cols)
  for (j in 0:(cols - 1)) {
    idx <- i + j * per_col
    if (idx <= n) {
      row[j + 1] <- paste0('[<small>', subplot_prefix, '<small>**', idx, '**](#subplot-', idx, ')')
    } else {
      row[j + 1] <- ' '
    }
  }
  toc_lines <- c(toc_lines, paste(row, collapse = ' | '))
}
cat(paste(toc_lines, collapse = '\n'))
```

### Subparcela 1 {#subplot-1 .unlisted .unnumbered}

```{r subplot-1, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
sp_data <- params$subplots_list[[1]]$data
if (knitr::is_html_output() && !is.null(params$subplots_list[[1]]$data)) {
  if (nrow(sp_data) == 0L) {
    if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[1]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[1]]$plot)
  } else {
    x_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'x10' else 'X'
    y_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'y10' else 'Y'
    sz <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 10 else params$subplot_size
    status_vec <- if ('Status' %in% names(sp_data)) as.integer(sp_data$Status) else rep(NA_integer_, nrow(sp_data))
    diam_vec <- if ('diameter' %in% names(sp_data)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$diameter)) else suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D) / 10)
    diam_vec[!is.finite(diam_vec)] <- 0
    pt_colors <- dplyr::case_when(
      status_vec == 1L ~ 'gray80',
      status_vec == 2L ~ '#EF4444',
      status_vec == 3L ~ 'gold',
      TRUE ~ 'gray80'
    )
    pt_sizes <- pmax(1 + diam_vec * 1.5, 6)
    tag_ids <- gsub('[^A-Za-z0-9-]', '', trimws(as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']])))
    hover <- paste0(
      '<b>Tag:</b> ', sp_data[['New Tag No']], '<br>',
      '<b>Species:</b> ', sp_data[['Original determination']], '<br>',
      '<b>DBH:</b> ', round(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D)) / 10, 1), ' cm<br>'
    )
    sp_ticks <- seq(0, sz, by = 2.5)
    sp_tick_labels <- paste0(sp_ticks, ' m')
    p <- plotly::plot_ly(
      x = sp_data[[x_col]],
      y = sp_data[[y_col]],
      type = 'scatter',
      mode = 'markers+text',
      marker = list(
        color = pt_colors,
        size = pt_sizes,
        line = list(color = 'black', width = 0.8),
        symbol = 'circle'
      ),
      text = as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']]),
      textposition = 'middle center',
      textfont = list(size = 8, color = 'black'),
      hovertext = hover,
      hoverinfo = 'text',
      customdata = tag_ids,
      showlegend = FALSE
    ) %>%
      plotly::layout(
        xaxis = list(title = list(text = 'X (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), scaleanchor = 'y', scaleratio = 1, showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        yaxis = list(title = list(text = 'Y (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        shapes = list(list(type = 'rect', x0 = 0, x1 = sz, y0 = 0, y1 = sz, line = list(color = 'darkolivegreen', width = 2), fillcolor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', layer = 'below')),
        plot_bgcolor = 'white',
        paper_bgcolor = 'white',
        margin = list(l = 5, r = 10, t = 60, b = 30)
      ) %>%
      plotly::config(displaylogo = FALSE, responsive = TRUE, displayModeBar = TRUE, modeBarButtonsToRemove = c('lasso2d', 'select2d'), toImageButtonOptions = list(format = 'png', scale = 2)) %>%
      htmlwidgets::onRender(
        'function(el) {
          el.on("plotly_click", function(d) {
            if (!d.points || !d.points.length) return;
            var t = d.points[0].customdata;
            if (!t) return;
            var a = document.getElementById("checklist-tag-" + t);
            if (a) a.scrollIntoView({behavior: "smooth", block: "center"});
          });
        }'
      )
    p
  }
} else {
  if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[1]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[1]]$plot)
}
```

### Subparcela 5 {#subplot-5 .unlisted .unnumbered}

```{r subplot-5, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
sp_data <- params$subplots_list[[5]]$data
if (knitr::is_html_output() && !is.null(params$subplots_list[[5]]$data)) {
  if (nrow(sp_data) == 0L) {
    if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[5]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[5]]$plot)
  } else {
    x_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'x10' else 'X'
    y_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'y10' else 'Y'
    sz <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 10 else params$subplot_size
    status_vec <- if ('Status' %in% names(sp_data)) as.integer(sp_data$Status) else rep(NA_integer_, nrow(sp_data))
    diam_vec <- if ('diameter' %in% names(sp_data)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$diameter)) else suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D) / 10)
    diam_vec[!is.finite(diam_vec)] <- 0
    pt_colors <- dplyr::case_when(
      status_vec == 1L ~ 'gray80',
      status_vec == 2L ~ '#EF4444',
      status_vec == 3L ~ 'gold',
      TRUE ~ 'gray80'
    )
    pt_sizes <- pmax(1 + diam_vec * 1.5, 6)
    tag_ids <- gsub('[^A-Za-z0-9-]', '', trimws(as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']])))
    hover <- paste0(
      '<b>Tag:</b> ', sp_data[['New Tag No']], '<br>',
      '<b>Species:</b> ', sp_data[['Original determination']], '<br>',
      '<b>DBH:</b> ', round(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D)) / 10, 1), ' cm<br>'
    )
    sp_ticks <- seq(0, sz, by = 2.5)
    sp_tick_labels <- paste0(sp_ticks, ' m')
    p <- plotly::plot_ly(
      x = sp_data[[x_col]],
      y = sp_data[[y_col]],
      type = 'scatter',
      mode = 'markers+text',
      marker = list(
        color = pt_colors,
        size = pt_sizes,
        line = list(color = 'black', width = 0.8),
        symbol = 'circle'
      ),
      text = as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']]),
      textposition = 'middle center',
      textfont = list(size = 8, color = 'black'),
      hovertext = hover,
      hoverinfo = 'text',
      customdata = tag_ids,
      showlegend = FALSE
    ) %>%
      plotly::layout(
        xaxis = list(title = list(text = 'X (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), scaleanchor = 'y', scaleratio = 1, showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        yaxis = list(title = list(text = 'Y (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        shapes = list(list(type = 'rect', x0 = 0, x1 = sz, y0 = 0, y1 = sz, line = list(color = 'darkolivegreen', width = 2), fillcolor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', layer = 'below')),
        plot_bgcolor = 'white',
        paper_bgcolor = 'white',
        margin = list(l = 5, r = 10, t = 60, b = 30)
      ) %>%
      plotly::config(displaylogo = FALSE, responsive = TRUE, displayModeBar = TRUE, modeBarButtonsToRemove = c('lasso2d', 'select2d'), toImageButtonOptions = list(format = 'png', scale = 2)) %>%
      htmlwidgets::onRender(
        'function(el) {
          el.on("plotly_click", function(d) {
            if (!d.points || !d.points.length) return;
            var t = d.points[0].customdata;
            if (!t) return;
            var a = document.getElementById("checklist-tag-" + t);
            if (a) a.scrollIntoView({behavior: "smooth", block: "center"});
          });
        }'
      )
    p
  }
} else {
  if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[5]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[5]]$plot)
}
```

### Subparcela 9 {#subplot-9 .unlisted .unnumbered}

```{r subplot-9, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
sp_data <- params$subplots_list[[9]]$data
if (knitr::is_html_output() && !is.null(params$subplots_list[[9]]$data)) {
  if (nrow(sp_data) == 0L) {
    if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[9]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[9]]$plot)
  } else {
    x_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'x10' else 'X'
    y_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'y10' else 'Y'
    sz <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 10 else params$subplot_size
    status_vec <- if ('Status' %in% names(sp_data)) as.integer(sp_data$Status) else rep(NA_integer_, nrow(sp_data))
    diam_vec <- if ('diameter' %in% names(sp_data)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$diameter)) else suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D) / 10)
    diam_vec[!is.finite(diam_vec)] <- 0
    pt_colors <- dplyr::case_when(
      status_vec == 1L ~ 'gray80',
      status_vec == 2L ~ '#EF4444',
      status_vec == 3L ~ 'gold',
      TRUE ~ 'gray80'
    )
    pt_sizes <- pmax(1 + diam_vec * 1.5, 6)
    tag_ids <- gsub('[^A-Za-z0-9-]', '', trimws(as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']])))
    hover <- paste0(
      '<b>Tag:</b> ', sp_data[['New Tag No']], '<br>',
      '<b>Species:</b> ', sp_data[['Original determination']], '<br>',
      '<b>DBH:</b> ', round(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D)) / 10, 1), ' cm<br>'
    )
    sp_ticks <- seq(0, sz, by = 2.5)
    sp_tick_labels <- paste0(sp_ticks, ' m')
    p <- plotly::plot_ly(
      x = sp_data[[x_col]],
      y = sp_data[[y_col]],
      type = 'scatter',
      mode = 'markers+text',
      marker = list(
        color = pt_colors,
        size = pt_sizes,
        line = list(color = 'black', width = 0.8),
        symbol = 'circle'
      ),
      text = as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']]),
      textposition = 'middle center',
      textfont = list(size = 8, color = 'black'),
      hovertext = hover,
      hoverinfo = 'text',
      customdata = tag_ids,
      showlegend = FALSE
    ) %>%
      plotly::layout(
        xaxis = list(title = list(text = 'X (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), scaleanchor = 'y', scaleratio = 1, showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        yaxis = list(title = list(text = 'Y (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        shapes = list(list(type = 'rect', x0 = 0, x1 = sz, y0 = 0, y1 = sz, line = list(color = 'darkolivegreen', width = 2), fillcolor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', layer = 'below')),
        plot_bgcolor = 'white',
        paper_bgcolor = 'white',
        margin = list(l = 5, r = 10, t = 60, b = 30)
      ) %>%
      plotly::config(displaylogo = FALSE, responsive = TRUE, displayModeBar = TRUE, modeBarButtonsToRemove = c('lasso2d', 'select2d'), toImageButtonOptions = list(format = 'png', scale = 2)) %>%
      htmlwidgets::onRender(
        'function(el) {
          el.on("plotly_click", function(d) {
            if (!d.points || !d.points.length) return;
            var t = d.points[0].customdata;
            if (!t) return;
            var a = document.getElementById("checklist-tag-" + t);
            if (a) a.scrollIntoView({behavior: "smooth", block: "center"});
          });
        }'
      )
    p
  }
} else {
  if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[9]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[9]]$plot)
}
```

### Subparcela 13 {#subplot-13 .unlisted .unnumbered}

```{r subplot-13, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
sp_data <- params$subplots_list[[13]]$data
if (knitr::is_html_output() && !is.null(params$subplots_list[[13]]$data)) {
  if (nrow(sp_data) == 0L) {
    if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[13]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[13]]$plot)
  } else {
    x_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'x10' else 'X'
    y_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'y10' else 'Y'
    sz <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 10 else params$subplot_size
    status_vec <- if ('Status' %in% names(sp_data)) as.integer(sp_data$Status) else rep(NA_integer_, nrow(sp_data))
    diam_vec <- if ('diameter' %in% names(sp_data)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$diameter)) else suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D) / 10)
    diam_vec[!is.finite(diam_vec)] <- 0
    pt_colors <- dplyr::case_when(
      status_vec == 1L ~ 'gray80',
      status_vec == 2L ~ '#EF4444',
      status_vec == 3L ~ 'gold',
      TRUE ~ 'gray80'
    )
    pt_sizes <- pmax(1 + diam_vec * 1.5, 6)
    tag_ids <- gsub('[^A-Za-z0-9-]', '', trimws(as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']])))
    hover <- paste0(
      '<b>Tag:</b> ', sp_data[['New Tag No']], '<br>',
      '<b>Species:</b> ', sp_data[['Original determination']], '<br>',
      '<b>DBH:</b> ', round(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D)) / 10, 1), ' cm<br>'
    )
    sp_ticks <- seq(0, sz, by = 2.5)
    sp_tick_labels <- paste0(sp_ticks, ' m')
    p <- plotly::plot_ly(
      x = sp_data[[x_col]],
      y = sp_data[[y_col]],
      type = 'scatter',
      mode = 'markers+text',
      marker = list(
        color = pt_colors,
        size = pt_sizes,
        line = list(color = 'black', width = 0.8),
        symbol = 'circle'
      ),
      text = as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']]),
      textposition = 'middle center',
      textfont = list(size = 8, color = 'black'),
      hovertext = hover,
      hoverinfo = 'text',
      customdata = tag_ids,
      showlegend = FALSE
    ) %>%
      plotly::layout(
        xaxis = list(title = list(text = 'X (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), scaleanchor = 'y', scaleratio = 1, showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        yaxis = list(title = list(text = 'Y (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        shapes = list(list(type = 'rect', x0 = 0, x1 = sz, y0 = 0, y1 = sz, line = list(color = 'darkolivegreen', width = 2), fillcolor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', layer = 'below')),
        plot_bgcolor = 'white',
        paper_bgcolor = 'white',
        margin = list(l = 5, r = 10, t = 60, b = 30)
      ) %>%
      plotly::config(displaylogo = FALSE, responsive = TRUE, displayModeBar = TRUE, modeBarButtonsToRemove = c('lasso2d', 'select2d'), toImageButtonOptions = list(format = 'png', scale = 2)) %>%
      htmlwidgets::onRender(
        'function(el) {
          el.on("plotly_click", function(d) {
            if (!d.points || !d.points.length) return;
            var t = d.points[0].customdata;
            if (!t) return;
            var a = document.getElementById("checklist-tag-" + t);
            if (a) a.scrollIntoView({behavior: "smooth", block: "center"});
          });
        }'
      )
    p
  }
} else {
  if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[13]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[13]]$plot)
}
```

```{r subplot-17, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
sp_data <- params$subplots_list[[17]]$data
if (knitr::is_html_output() && !is.null(params$subplots_list[[17]]$data)) {
  if (nrow(sp_data) == 0L) {
    if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[17]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[17]]$plot)
  } else {
    x_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'x10' else 'X'
    y_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'y10' else 'Y'
    sz <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 10 else params$subplot_size
    status_vec <- if ('Status' %in% names(sp_data)) as.integer(sp_data$Status) else rep(NA_integer_, nrow(sp_data))
    diam_vec <- if ('diameter' %in% names(sp_data)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$diameter)) else suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D) / 10)
    diam_vec[!is.finite(diam_vec)] <- 0
    pt_colors <- dplyr::case_when(
      status_vec == 1L ~ 'gray80',
      status_vec == 2L ~ '#EF4444',
      status_vec == 3L ~ 'gold',
      TRUE ~ 'gray80'
    )
    pt_sizes <- pmax(1 + diam_vec * 1.5, 6)
    tag_ids <- gsub('[^A-Za-z0-9-]', '', trimws(as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']])))
    hover <- paste0(
      '<b>Tag:</b> ', sp_data[['New Tag No']], '<br>',
      '<b>Species:</b> ', sp_data[['Original determination']], '<br>',
      '<b>DBH:</b> ', round(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D)) / 10, 1), ' cm<br>'
    )
    sp_ticks <- seq(0, sz, by = 2.5)
    sp_tick_labels <- paste0(sp_ticks, ' m')
    p <- plotly::plot_ly(
      x = sp_data[[x_col]],
      y = sp_data[[y_col]],
      type = 'scatter',
      mode = 'markers+text',
      marker = list(
        color = pt_colors,
        size = pt_sizes,
        line = list(color = 'black', width = 0.8),
        symbol = 'circle'
      ),
      text = as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']]),
      textposition = 'middle center',
      textfont = list(size = 8, color = 'black'),
      hovertext = hover,
      hoverinfo = 'text',
      customdata = tag_ids,
      showlegend = FALSE
    ) %>%
      plotly::layout(
        xaxis = list(title = list(text = 'X (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), scaleanchor = 'y', scaleratio = 1, showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        yaxis = list(title = list(text = 'Y (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        shapes = list(list(type = 'rect', x0 = 0, x1 = sz, y0 = 0, y1 = sz, line = list(color = 'darkolivegreen', width = 2), fillcolor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', layer = 'below')),
        plot_bgcolor = 'white',
        paper_bgcolor = 'white',
        margin = list(l = 5, r = 10, t = 60, b = 30)
      ) %>%
      plotly::config(displaylogo = FALSE, responsive = TRUE, displayModeBar = TRUE, modeBarButtonsToRemove = c('lasso2d', 'select2d'), toImageButtonOptions = list(format = 'png', scale = 2)) %>%
      htmlwidgets::onRender(
        'function(el) {
          el.on("plotly_click", function(d) {
            if (!d.points || !d.points.length) return;
            var t = d.points[0].customdata;
            if (!t) return;
            var a = document.getElementById("checklist-tag-" + t);
            if (a) a.scrollIntoView({behavior: "smooth", block: "center"});
          });
        }'
      )
    p
  }
} else {
  if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[17]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[17]]$plot)
}
```

```{r subplot-18, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
    sz <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 10 else params$subplot_size
    status_vec <- if ('Status' %in% names(sp_data)) as.integer(sp_data$Status) else rep(NA_integer_, nrow(sp_data))
    diam_vec <- if ('diameter' %in% names(sp_data)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$diameter)) else suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D) / 10)
    diam_vec[!is.finite(diam_vec)] <- 0
    pt_colors <- dplyr::case_when(
      status_vec == 1L ~ 'gray80',
      status_vec == 2L ~ '#EF4444',
      status_vec == 3L ~ 'gold',
      TRUE ~ 'gray80'
    )
    pt_sizes <- pmax(1 + diam_vec * 1.5, 6)
    tag_ids <- gsub('[^A-Za-z0-9-]', '', trimws(as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']])))
    hover <- paste0(
      '<b>Tag:</b> ', sp_data[['New Tag No']], '<br>',
      '<b>Species:</b> ', sp_data[['Original determination']], '<br>',
      '<b>DBH:</b> ', round(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D)) / 10, 1), ' cm<br>'
    )
    sp_ticks <- seq(0, sz, by = 2.5)
    sp_tick_labels <- paste0(sp_ticks, ' m')
    p <- plotly::plot_ly(
      x = sp_data[[x_col]],
      y = sp_data[[y_col]],
      type = 'scatter',
      mode = 'markers+text',
      marker = list(
        color = pt_colors,
        size = pt_sizes,
        line = list(color = 'black', width = 0.8),
        symbol = 'circle'
      ),
      text = as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']]),
      textposition = 'middle center',
      textfont = list(size = 8, color = 'black'),
      hovertext = hover,
      hoverinfo = 'text',
      customdata = tag_ids,
      showlegend = FALSE
    ) %>%
      plotly::layout(
        xaxis = list(title = list(text = 'X (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), scaleanchor = 'y', scaleratio = 1, showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        yaxis = list(title = list(text = 'Y (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        shapes = list(list(type = 'rect', x0 = 0, x1 = sz, y0 = 0, y1 = sz, line = list(color = 'darkolivegreen', width = 2), fillcolor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', layer = 'below')),
        plot_bgcolor = 'white',
        paper_bgcolor = 'white',
        margin = list(l = 5, r = 10, t = 60, b = 30)
      ) %>%
      plotly::config(displaylogo = FALSE, responsive = TRUE, displayModeBar = TRUE, modeBarButtonsToRemove = c('lasso2d', 'select2d'), toImageButtonOptions = list(format = 'png', scale = 2)) %>%
      htmlwidgets::onRender(
```

```{r subplot-30, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
sp_data <- params$subplots_list[[30]]$data
if (knitr::is_html_output() && !is.null(params$subplots_list[[30]]$data)) {
  if (nrow(sp_data) == 0L) {

  } else {
    x_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'x10' else 'X'
```

### Subparcela 34 {#subplot-34 .unlisted .unnumbered}

```{r subplot-34, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
sp_data <- params$subplots_list[[34]]$data
if (knitr::is_html_output() && !is.null(params$subplots_list[[34]]$data)) {
  if (nrow(sp_data) == 0L) {
    if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[34]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[34]]$plot)
  } else {
    x_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'x10' else 'X'
    y_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'y10' else 'Y'
    sz <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 10 else params$subplot_size
    status_vec <- if ('Status' %in% names(sp_data)) as.integer(sp_data$Status) else rep(NA_integer_, nrow(sp_data))
    diam_vec <- if ('diameter' %in% names(sp_data)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$diameter)) else suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D) / 10)
    diam_vec[!is.finite(diam_vec)] <- 0
    pt_colors <- dplyr::case_when(
      status_vec == 1L ~ 'gray80',
      status_vec == 2L ~ '#EF4444',
      status_vec == 3L ~ 'gold',
      TRUE ~ 'gray80'
    )
    pt_sizes <- pmax(1 + diam_vec * 1.5, 6)
    tag_ids <- gsub('[^A-Za-z0-9-]', '', trimws(as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']])))
    hover <- paste0(
      '<b>Tag:</b> ', sp_data[['New Tag No']], '<br>',
      '<b>Species:</b> ', sp_data[['Original determination']], '<br>',
      '<b>DBH:</b> ', round(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D)) / 10, 1), ' cm<br>'
    )
    sp_ticks <- seq(0, sz, by = 2.5)
    sp_tick_labels <- paste0(sp_ticks, ' m')
    p <- plotly::plot_ly(
      x = sp_data[[x_col]],
      y = sp_data[[y_col]],
      type = 'scatter',
      mode = 'markers+text',
      marker = list(
        color = pt_colors,
        size = pt_sizes,
        line = list(color = 'black', width = 0.8),
        symbol = 'circle'
      ),
      text = as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']]),
      textposition = 'middle center',
      textfont = list(size = 8, color = 'black'),
      hovertext = hover,
      hoverinfo = 'text',
      customdata = tag_ids,
      showlegend = FALSE
    ) %>%
      plotly::layout(
        xaxis = list(title = list(text = 'X (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), scaleanchor = 'y', scaleratio = 1, showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        yaxis = list(title = list(text = 'Y (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        shapes = list(list(type = 'rect', x0 = 0, x1 = sz, y0 = 0, y1 = sz, line = list(color = 'darkolivegreen', width = 2), fillcolor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', layer = 'below')),
        plot_bgcolor = 'white',
        paper_bgcolor = 'white',
        margin = list(l = 5, r = 10, t = 60, b = 30)
      ) %>%
      plotly::config(displaylogo = FALSE, responsive = TRUE, displayModeBar = TRUE, modeBarButtonsToRemove = c('lasso2d', 'select2d'), toImageButtonOptions = list(format = 'png', scale = 2)) %>%
      htmlwidgets::onRender(
        'function(el) {
          el.on("plotly_click", function(d) {
            if (!d.points || !d.points.length) return;
            var t = d.points[0].customdata;
            if (!t) return;
            var a = document.getElementById("checklist-tag-" + t);
            if (a) a.scrollIntoView({behavior: "smooth", block: "center"});
          });
        }'
      )
    p
  }
```

### Subparcela 38 {#subplot-38 .unlisted .unnumbered}

```{r subplot-38, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
sp_data <- params$subplots_list[[38]]$data
if (knitr::is_html_output() && !is.null(params$subplots_list[[38]]$data)) {
  if (nrow(sp_data) == 0L) {
    if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[38]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[38]]$plot)
  } else {
    x_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'x10' else 'X'
    y_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'y10' else 'Y'
    sz <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 10 else params$subplot_size
    status_vec <- if ('Status' %in% names(sp_data)) as.integer(sp_data$Status) else rep(NA_integer_, nrow(sp_data))
    diam_vec <- if ('diameter' %in% names(sp_data)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$diameter)) else suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D) / 10)
    diam_vec[!is.finite(diam_vec)] <- 0
    pt_colors <- dplyr::case_when(
      status_vec == 1L ~ 'gray80',
      status_vec == 2L ~ '#EF4444',
      status_vec == 3L ~ 'gold',
      TRUE ~ 'gray80'
    )
    pt_sizes <- pmax(1 + diam_vec * 1.5, 6)
    tag_ids <- gsub('[^A-Za-z0-9-]', '', trimws(as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']])))
    hover <- paste0(
      '<b>Tag:</b> ', sp_data[['New Tag No']], '<br>',
      '<b>Species:</b> ', sp_data[['Original determination']], '<br>',
      '<b>DBH:</b> ', round(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D)) / 10, 1), ' cm<br>'
    )
    sp_ticks <- seq(0, sz, by = 2.5)
    sp_tick_labels <- paste0(sp_ticks, ' m')
    p <- plotly::plot_ly(
      x = sp_data[[x_col]],
      y = sp_data[[y_col]],
      type = 'scatter',
      mode = 'markers+text',
      marker = list(
        color = pt_colors,
        size = pt_sizes,
        line = list(color = 'black', width = 0.8),
        symbol = 'circle'
      ),
      text = as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']]),
      textposition = 'middle center',
      textfont = list(size = 8, color = 'black'),
      hovertext = hover,
      hoverinfo = 'text',
      customdata = tag_ids,
      showlegend = FALSE
    ) %>%
      plotly::layout(
        xaxis = list(title = list(text = 'X (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), scaleanchor = 'y', scaleratio = 1, showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        yaxis = list(title = list(text = 'Y (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        shapes = list(list(type = 'rect', x0 = 0, x1 = sz, y0 = 0, y1 = sz, line = list(color = 'darkolivegreen', width = 2), fillcolor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', layer = 'below')),
        plot_bgcolor = 'white',
        paper_bgcolor = 'white',
        margin = list(l = 5, r = 10, t = 60, b = 30)
      ) %>%
      plotly::config(displaylogo = FALSE, responsive = TRUE, displayModeBar = TRUE, modeBarButtonsToRemove = c('lasso2d', 'select2d'), toImageButtonOptions = list(format = 'png', scale = 2)) %>%
      htmlwidgets::onRender(
        'function(el) {
          el.on("plotly_click", function(d) {
            if (!d.points || !d.points.length) return;
            var t = d.points[0].customdata;
            if (!t) return;
            var a = document.getElementById("checklist-tag-" + t);
            if (a) a.scrollIntoView({behavior: "smooth", block: "center"});
          });
        }'
      )
    p
  }
} else {
  if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[38]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[38]]$plot)
}
```

### Subparcela 42 {#subplot-42 .unlisted .unnumbered}

```{r subplot-42, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
sp_data <- params$subplots_list[[42]]$data
if (knitr::is_html_output() && !is.null(params$subplots_list[[42]]$data)) {
  if (nrow(sp_data) == 0L) {
    if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[42]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[42]]$plot)
  } else {
    x_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'x10' else 'X'
    y_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'y10' else 'Y'
    sz <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 10 else params$subplot_size
    status_vec <- if ('Status' %in% names(sp_data)) as.integer(sp_data$Status) else rep(NA_integer_, nrow(sp_data))
    diam_vec <- if ('diameter' %in% names(sp_data)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$diameter)) else suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D) / 10)
    diam_vec[!is.finite(diam_vec)] <- 0
    pt_colors <- dplyr::case_when(
      status_vec == 1L ~ 'gray80',
      status_vec == 2L ~ '#EF4444',
      status_vec == 3L ~ 'gold',
      TRUE ~ 'gray80'
    )
    pt_sizes <- pmax(1 + diam_vec * 1.5, 6)
    tag_ids <- gsub('[^A-Za-z0-9-]', '', trimws(as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']])))
    hover <- paste0(
      '<b>Tag:</b> ', sp_data[['New Tag No']], '<br>',
      '<b>Species:</b> ', sp_data[['Original determination']], '<br>',
      '<b>DBH:</b> ', round(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D)) / 10, 1), ' cm<br>'
    )
    sp_ticks <- seq(0, sz, by = 2.5)
    sp_tick_labels <- paste0(sp_ticks, ' m')
    p <- plotly::plot_ly(
      x = sp_data[[x_col]],
      y = sp_data[[y_col]],
      type = 'scatter',
      mode = 'markers+text',
      marker = list(
        color = pt_colors,
        size = pt_sizes,
        line = list(color = 'black', width = 0.8),
        symbol = 'circle'
      ),
      text = as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']]),
      textposition = 'middle center',
      textfont = list(size = 8, color = 'black'),
      hovertext = hover,
      hoverinfo = 'text',
      customdata = tag_ids,
      showlegend = FALSE
    ) %>%
      plotly::layout(
        xaxis = list(title = list(text = 'X (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), scaleanchor = 'y', scaleratio = 1, showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        yaxis = list(title = list(text = 'Y (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        shapes = list(list(type = 'rect', x0 = 0, x1 = sz, y0 = 0, y1 = sz, line = list(color = 'darkolivegreen', width = 2), fillcolor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', layer = 'below')),
        plot_bgcolor = 'white',
        paper_bgcolor = 'white',
        margin = list(l = 5, r = 10, t = 60, b = 30)
      ) %>%
      plotly::config(displaylogo = FALSE, responsive = TRUE, displayModeBar = TRUE, modeBarButtonsToRemove = c('lasso2d', 'select2d'), toImageButtonOptions = list(format = 'png', scale = 2)) %>%
      htmlwidgets::onRender(
        'function(el) {
          el.on("plotly_click", function(d) {
            if (!d.points || !d.points.length) return;
            var t = d.points[0].customdata;
            if (!t) return;
            var a = document.getElementById("checklist-tag-" + t);
            if (a) a.scrollIntoView({behavior: "smooth", block: "center"});
          });
        }'
      )
    p
  }
} else {
  if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[42]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[42]]$plot)
}
```

### Subparcela 46 {#subplot-46 .unlisted .unnumbered}

```{r subplot-46, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
sp_data <- params$subplots_list[[46]]$data
if (knitr::is_html_output() && !is.null(params$subplots_list[[46]]$data)) {
  if (nrow(sp_data) == 0L) {
    if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[46]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[46]]$plot)
  } else {
    x_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'x10' else 'X'
    y_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'y10' else 'Y'
    sz <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 10 else params$subplot_size
    status_vec <- if ('Status' %in% names(sp_data)) as.integer(sp_data$Status) else rep(NA_integer_, nrow(sp_data))
    diam_vec <- if ('diameter' %in% names(sp_data)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$diameter)) else suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D) / 10)
    diam_vec[!is.finite(diam_vec)] <- 0
    pt_colors <- dplyr::case_when(
      status_vec == 1L ~ 'gray80',
      status_vec == 2L ~ '#EF4444',
      status_vec == 3L ~ 'gold',
      TRUE ~ 'gray80'
    )
    pt_sizes <- pmax(1 + diam_vec * 1.5, 6)
    tag_ids <- gsub('[^A-Za-z0-9-]', '', trimws(as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']])))
    hover <- paste0(
      '<b>Tag:</b> ', sp_data[['New Tag No']], '<br>',
      '<b>Species:</b> ', sp_data[['Original determination']], '<br>',
      '<b>DBH:</b> ', round(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D)) / 10, 1), ' cm<br>'
    )
    sp_ticks <- seq(0, sz, by = 2.5)
    sp_tick_labels <- paste0(sp_ticks, ' m')
    p <- plotly::plot_ly(
      x = sp_data[[x_col]],
      y = sp_data[[y_col]],
      type = 'scatter',
      mode = 'markers+text',
      marker = list(
        color = pt_colors,
        size = pt_sizes,
        line = list(color = 'black', width = 0.8),
        symbol = 'circle'
      ),
      text = as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']]),
      textposition = 'middle center',
      textfont = list(size = 8, color = 'black'),
      hovertext = hover,
      hoverinfo = 'text',
      customdata = tag_ids,
      showlegend = FALSE
    ) %>%
      plotly::layout(
        xaxis = list(title = list(text = 'X (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), scaleanchor = 'y', scaleratio = 1, showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        yaxis = list(title = list(text = 'Y (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        shapes = list(list(type = 'rect', x0 = 0, x1 = sz, y0 = 0, y1 = sz, line = list(color = 'darkolivegreen', width = 2), fillcolor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', layer = 'below')),
        plot_bgcolor = 'white',
        paper_bgcolor = 'white',
        margin = list(l = 5, r = 10, t = 60, b = 30)
      ) %>%
      plotly::config(displaylogo = FALSE, responsive = TRUE, displayModeBar = TRUE, modeBarButtonsToRemove = c('lasso2d', 'select2d'), toImageButtonOptions = list(format = 'png', scale = 2)) %>%
      htmlwidgets::onRender(
        'function(el) {
          el.on("plotly_click", function(d) {
            if (!d.points || !d.points.length) return;
            var t = d.points[0].customdata;
            if (!t) return;
            var a = document.getElementById("checklist-tag-" + t);
            if (a) a.scrollIntoView({behavior: "smooth", block: "center"});
          });
        }'
      )
    p
  }
} else {
  if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[46]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[46]]$plot)
}
```

### Subparcela 50 {#subplot-50 .unlisted .unnumbered}

```{r subplot-50, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
sp_data <- params$subplots_list[[50]]$data
if (knitr::is_html_output() && !is.null(params$subplots_list[[50]]$data)) {
  if (nrow(sp_data) == 0L) {
    if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[50]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[50]]$plot)
  } else {
    x_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'x10' else 'X'
    y_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'y10' else 'Y'
    sz <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 10 else params$subplot_size
    status_vec <- if ('Status' %in% names(sp_data)) as.integer(sp_data$Status) else rep(NA_integer_, nrow(sp_data))
    diam_vec <- if ('diameter' %in% names(sp_data)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$diameter)) else suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D) / 10)
    diam_vec[!is.finite(diam_vec)] <- 0
    pt_colors <- dplyr::case_when(
      status_vec == 1L ~ 'gray80',
      status_vec == 2L ~ '#EF4444',
      status_vec == 3L ~ 'gold',
      TRUE ~ 'gray80'
    )
    pt_sizes <- pmax(1 + diam_vec * 1.5, 6)
    tag_ids <- gsub('[^A-Za-z0-9-]', '', trimws(as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']])))
    hover <- paste0(
      '<b>Tag:</b> ', sp_data[['New Tag No']], '<br>',
      '<b>Species:</b> ', sp_data[['Original determination']], '<br>',
      '<b>DBH:</b> ', round(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D)) / 10, 1), ' cm<br>'
    )
    sp_ticks <- seq(0, sz, by = 2.5)
    sp_tick_labels <- paste0(sp_ticks, ' m')
    p <- plotly::plot_ly(
      x = sp_data[[x_col]],
      y = sp_data[[y_col]],
      type = 'scatter',
      mode = 'markers+text',
      marker = list(
        color = pt_colors,
        size = pt_sizes,
        line = list(color = 'black', width = 0.8),
        symbol = 'circle'
      ),
      text = as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']]),
      textposition = 'middle center',
      textfont = list(size = 8, color = 'black'),
      hovertext = hover,
      hoverinfo = 'text',
      customdata = tag_ids,
      showlegend = FALSE
    ) %>%
      plotly::layout(
        xaxis = list(title = list(text = 'X (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), scaleanchor = 'y', scaleratio = 1, showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        yaxis = list(title = list(text = 'Y (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        shapes = list(list(type = 'rect', x0 = 0, x1 = sz, y0 = 0, y1 = sz, line = list(color = 'darkolivegreen', width = 2), fillcolor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', layer = 'below')),
        plot_bgcolor = 'white',
        paper_bgcolor = 'white',
        margin = list(l = 5, r = 10, t = 60, b = 30)
      ) %>%
      plotly::config(displaylogo = FALSE, responsive = TRUE, displayModeBar = TRUE, modeBarButtonsToRemove = c('lasso2d', 'select2d'), toImageButtonOptions = list(format = 'png', scale = 2)) %>%
      htmlwidgets::onRender(
        'function(el) {
          el.on("plotly_click", function(d) {
            if (!d.points || !d.points.length) return;
            var t = d.points[0].customdata;
            if (!t) return;
            var a = document.getElementById("checklist-tag-" + t);
            if (a) a.scrollIntoView({behavior: "smooth", block: "center"});
          });
        }'
      )
    p
  }
} else {
  if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[50]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[50]]$plot)
}
```

### Subparcela 54 {#subplot-54 .unlisted .unnumbered}

```{r subplot-54, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
sp_data <- params$subplots_list[[54]]$data
if (knitr::is_html_output() && !is.null(params$subplots_list[[54]]$data)) {
  if (nrow(sp_data) == 0L) {
    if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[54]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[54]]$plot)
  } else {
    x_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'x10' else 'X'
    y_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'y10' else 'Y'
    sz <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 10 else params$subplot_size
    status_vec <- if ('Status' %in% names(sp_data)) as.integer(sp_data$Status) else rep(NA_integer_, nrow(sp_data))
    diam_vec <- if ('diameter' %in% names(sp_data)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$diameter)) else suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D) / 10)
    diam_vec[!is.finite(diam_vec)] <- 0
    pt_colors <- dplyr::case_when(
      status_vec == 1L ~ 'gray80',
      status_vec == 2L ~ '#EF4444',
      status_vec == 3L ~ 'gold',
      TRUE ~ 'gray80'
    )
    pt_sizes <- pmax(1 + diam_vec * 1.5, 6)
    tag_ids <- gsub('[^A-Za-z0-9-]', '', trimws(as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']])))
    hover <- paste0(
      '<b>Tag:</b> ', sp_data[['New Tag No']], '<br>',
      '<b>Species:</b> ', sp_data[['Original determination']], '<br>',
      '<b>DBH:</b> ', round(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D)) / 10, 1), ' cm<br>'
    )
    sp_ticks <- seq(0, sz, by = 2.5)
    sp_tick_labels <- paste0(sp_ticks, ' m')
    p <- plotly::plot_ly(
      x = sp_data[[x_col]],
      y = sp_data[[y_col]],
      type = 'scatter',
      mode = 'markers+text',
      marker = list(
        color = pt_colors,
        size = pt_sizes,
        line = list(color = 'black', width = 0.8),
        symbol = 'circle'
      ),
      text = as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']]),
      textposition = 'middle center',
      textfont = list(size = 8, color = 'black'),
      hovertext = hover,
      hoverinfo = 'text',
      customdata = tag_ids,
      showlegend = FALSE
    ) %>%
      plotly::layout(
        xaxis = list(title = list(text = 'X (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), scaleanchor = 'y', scaleratio = 1, showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        yaxis = list(title = list(text = 'Y (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        shapes = list(list(type = 'rect', x0 = 0, x1 = sz, y0 = 0, y1 = sz, line = list(color = 'darkolivegreen', width = 2), fillcolor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', layer = 'below')),
        plot_bgcolor = 'white',
        paper_bgcolor = 'white',
        margin = list(l = 5, r = 10, t = 60, b = 30)
      ) %>%
      plotly::config(displaylogo = FALSE, responsive = TRUE, displayModeBar = TRUE, modeBarButtonsToRemove = c('lasso2d', 'select2d'), toImageButtonOptions = list(format = 'png', scale = 2)) %>%
      htmlwidgets::onRender(
        'function(el) {
          el.on("plotly_click", function(d) {
            if (!d.points || !d.points.length) return;
            var t = d.points[0].customdata;
            if (!t) return;
            var a = document.getElementById("checklist-tag-" + t);
            if (a) a.scrollIntoView({behavior: "smooth", block: "center"});
          });
        }'
      )
    p
  }
} else {
  if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[54]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[54]]$plot)
}
```

### Subparcela 58 {#subplot-58 .unlisted .unnumbered}

```{r subplot-58, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
sp_data <- params$subplots_list[[58]]$data
if (knitr::is_html_output() && !is.null(params$subplots_list[[58]]$data)) {
  if (nrow(sp_data) == 0L) {
    if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[58]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[58]]$plot)
  } else {
    x_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'x10' else 'X'
    y_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'y10' else 'Y'
    sz <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 10 else params$subplot_size
    status_vec <- if ('Status' %in% names(sp_data)) as.integer(sp_data$Status) else rep(NA_integer_, nrow(sp_data))
    diam_vec <- if ('diameter' %in% names(sp_data)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$diameter)) else suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D) / 10)
    diam_vec[!is.finite(diam_vec)] <- 0
    pt_colors <- dplyr::case_when(
      status_vec == 1L ~ 'gray80',
      status_vec == 2L ~ '#EF4444',
      status_vec == 3L ~ 'gold',
      TRUE ~ 'gray80'
    )
    pt_sizes <- pmax(1 + diam_vec * 1.5, 6)
    tag_ids <- gsub('[^A-Za-z0-9-]', '', trimws(as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']])))
    hover <- paste0(
      '<b>Tag:</b> ', sp_data[['New Tag No']], '<br>',
      '<b>Species:</b> ', sp_data[['Original determination']], '<br>',
      '<b>DBH:</b> ', round(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D)) / 10, 1), ' cm<br>'
    )
    sp_ticks <- seq(0, sz, by = 2.5)
    sp_tick_labels <- paste0(sp_ticks, ' m')
    p <- plotly::plot_ly(
      x = sp_data[[x_col]],
      y = sp_data[[y_col]],
      type = 'scatter',
      mode = 'markers+text',
      marker = list(
        color = pt_colors,
        size = pt_sizes,
        line = list(color = 'black', width = 0.8),
        symbol = 'circle'
      ),
      text = as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']]),
      textposition = 'middle center',
      textfont = list(size = 8, color = 'black'),
      hovertext = hover,
      hoverinfo = 'text',
      customdata = tag_ids,
      showlegend = FALSE
    ) %>%
      plotly::layout(
        xaxis = list(title = list(text = 'X (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), scaleanchor = 'y', scaleratio = 1, showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        yaxis = list(title = list(text = 'Y (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        shapes = list(list(type = 'rect', x0 = 0, x1 = sz, y0 = 0, y1 = sz, line = list(color = 'darkolivegreen', width = 2), fillcolor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', layer = 'below')),
        plot_bgcolor = 'white',
        paper_bgcolor = 'white',
        margin = list(l = 5, r = 10, t = 60, b = 30)
      ) %>%
      plotly::config(displaylogo = FALSE, responsive = TRUE, displayModeBar = TRUE, modeBarButtonsToRemove = c('lasso2d', 'select2d'), toImageButtonOptions = list(format = 'png', scale = 2)) %>%
      htmlwidgets::onRender(
        'function(el) {
          el.on("plotly_click", function(d) {
            if (!d.points || !d.points.length) return;
            var t = d.points[0].customdata;
            if (!t) return;
            var a = document.getElementById("checklist-tag-" + t);
            if (a) a.scrollIntoView({behavior: "smooth", block: "center"});
          });
        }'
      )
    p
  }
} else {
  if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[58]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[58]]$plot)
}
```

### Subparcela 62 {#subplot-62 .unlisted .unnumbered}

```{r subplot-62, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
sp_data <- params$subplots_list[[62]]$data
if (knitr::is_html_output() && !is.null(params$subplots_list[[62]]$data)) {
  if (nrow(sp_data) == 0L) {
    if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[62]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[62]]$plot)
  } else {
    x_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'x10' else 'X'
    y_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'y10' else 'Y'
    sz <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 10 else params$subplot_size
    status_vec <- if ('Status' %in% names(sp_data)) as.integer(sp_data$Status) else rep(NA_integer_, nrow(sp_data))
    diam_vec <- if ('diameter' %in% names(sp_data)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$diameter)) else suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D) / 10)
    diam_vec[!is.finite(diam_vec)] <- 0
    pt_colors <- dplyr::case_when(
      status_vec == 1L ~ 'gray80',
      status_vec == 2L ~ '#EF4444',
      status_vec == 3L ~ 'gold',
      TRUE ~ 'gray80'
    )
    pt_sizes <- pmax(1 + diam_vec * 1.5, 6)
    tag_ids <- gsub('[^A-Za-z0-9-]', '', trimws(as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']])))
    hover <- paste0(
      '<b>Tag:</b> ', sp_data[['New Tag No']], '<br>',
      '<b>Species:</b> ', sp_data[['Original determination']], '<br>',
      '<b>DBH:</b> ', round(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D)) / 10, 1), ' cm<br>'
    )
    sp_ticks <- seq(0, sz, by = 2.5)
    sp_tick_labels <- paste0(sp_ticks, ' m')
    p <- plotly::plot_ly(
      x = sp_data[[x_col]],
      y = sp_data[[y_col]],
      type = 'scatter',
      mode = 'markers+text',
      marker = list(
        color = pt_colors,
        size = pt_sizes,
        line = list(color = 'black', width = 0.8),
        symbol = 'circle'
      ),
      text = as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']]),
      textposition = 'middle center',
      textfont = list(size = 8, color = 'black'),
      hovertext = hover,
      hoverinfo = 'text',
      customdata = tag_ids,
      showlegend = FALSE
    ) %>%
      plotly::layout(
        xaxis = list(title = list(text = 'X (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), scaleanchor = 'y', scaleratio = 1, showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        yaxis = list(title = list(text = 'Y (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        shapes = list(list(type = 'rect', x0 = 0, x1 = sz, y0 = 0, y1 = sz, line = list(color = 'darkolivegreen', width = 2), fillcolor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', layer = 'below')),
        plot_bgcolor = 'white',
        paper_bgcolor = 'white',
        margin = list(l = 5, r = 10, t = 60, b = 30)
      ) %>%
      plotly::config(displaylogo = FALSE, responsive = TRUE, displayModeBar = TRUE, modeBarButtonsToRemove = c('lasso2d', 'select2d'), toImageButtonOptions = list(format = 'png', scale = 2)) %>%
      htmlwidgets::onRender(
        'function(el) {
          el.on("plotly_click", function(d) {
            if (!d.points || !d.points.length) return;
            var t = d.points[0].customdata;
            if (!t) return;
            var a = document.getElementById("checklist-tag-" + t);
            if (a) a.scrollIntoView({behavior: "smooth", block: "center"});
          });
        }'
      )
    p
  }
} else {
  if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[62]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[62]]$plot)
}
```

```{r subplot-63, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
    )

    )
    sp_ticks <- seq(0, sz, by = 2.5)
    sp_tick_labels <- paste0(sp_ticks, ' m')
    p <- plotly::plot_ly(
      x = sp_data[[x_col]],
      y = sp_data[[y_col]],

      mode = 'markers+text',

        color = pt_colors,
        size = pt_sizes,
        line = list(color = 'black', width = 0.8),
        symbol = 'circle'
      ),
      text = as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']]),
      textposition = 'middle center',
      textfont = list(size = 8, color = 'black'),
      hovertext = hover,
      hoverinfo = 'text',
      customdata = tag_ids,
      showlegend = FALSE
    ) %>%
      plotly::layout(
        xaxis = list(title = list(text = 'X (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), scaleanchor = 'y', scaleratio = 1, showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        yaxis = list(title = list(text = 'Y (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        shapes = list(list(type = 'rect', x0 = 0, x1 = sz, y0 = 0, y1 = sz, line = list(color = 'darkolivegreen', width = 2), fillcolor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', layer = 'below')),
        plot_bgcolor = 'white',

        margin = list(l = 5, r = 10, t = 60, b = 30)
      ) %>%

      htmlwidgets::onRender(

            var t = d.points[0].customdata;
            if (!t) return;
            var a = document.getElementById("checklist-tag-" + t);
            if (a) a.scrollIntoView({behavior: "smooth", block: "center"});
          });
        }'
      )
    p
  }
} else {
```
```{r subplot-66, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
  if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[66]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[66]]$plot)
}
```

```{r subplot-67, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
    diam_vec <- if ('diameter' %in% names(sp_data)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$diameter)) else suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D) / 10)
    diam_vec[!is.finite(diam_vec)] <- 0
    pt_colors <- dplyr::case_when(
      status_vec == 1L ~ 'gray80',
      status_vec == 2L ~ '#EF4444',

    )

    tag_ids <- gsub('[^A-Za-z0-9-]', '', trimws(as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']])))

      '<b>Species:</b> ', sp_data[['Original determination']], '<br>',
      '<b>DBH:</b> ', round(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D)) / 10, 1), ' cm<br>'
    )
    sp_ticks <- seq(0, sz, by = 2.5)

    p <- plotly::plot_ly(
      x = sp_data[[x_col]],
      y = sp_data[[y_col]],

      marker = list(
        color = pt_colors,
        size = pt_sizes,
        line = list(color = 'black', width = 0.8),
        symbol = 'circle'
      ),
      text = as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']]),

      textfont = list(size = 8, color = 'black'),
      hovertext = hover,
      hoverinfo = 'text',
      customdata = tag_ids,
      showlegend = FALSE
    ) %>%
      plotly::layout(
        xaxis = list(title = list(text = 'X (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), scaleanchor = 'y', scaleratio = 1, showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        yaxis = list(title = list(text = 'Y (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        shapes = list(list(type = 'rect', x0 = 0, x1 = sz, y0 = 0, y1 = sz, line = list(color = 'darkolivegreen', width = 2), fillcolor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', layer = 'below')),
        plot_bgcolor = 'white',
        paper_bgcolor = 'white',

      htmlwidgets::onRender(
```

### Subparcela 83 {#subplot-83 .unlisted .unnumbered}

```{r subplot-83, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
sp_data <- params$subplots_list[[83]]$data
if (knitr::is_html_output() && !is.null(params$subplots_list[[83]]$data)) {
  if (nrow(sp_data) == 0L) {
    if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[83]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[83]]$plot)
  } else {
    x_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'x10' else 'X'
    y_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'y10' else 'Y'
    sz <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 10 else params$subplot_size
    status_vec <- if ('Status' %in% names(sp_data)) as.integer(sp_data$Status) else rep(NA_integer_, nrow(sp_data))
    diam_vec <- if ('diameter' %in% names(sp_data)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$diameter)) else suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D) / 10)
    diam_vec[!is.finite(diam_vec)] <- 0
    pt_colors <- dplyr::case_when(
      status_vec == 1L ~ 'gray80',
      status_vec == 2L ~ '#EF4444',
      status_vec == 3L ~ 'gold',
      TRUE ~ 'gray80'
    )
    pt_sizes <- pmax(1 + diam_vec * 1.5, 6)
    tag_ids <- gsub('[^A-Za-z0-9-]', '', trimws(as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']])))
    hover <- paste0(
      '<b>Tag:</b> ', sp_data[['New Tag No']], '<br>',
      '<b>Species:</b> ', sp_data[['Original determination']], '<br>',
      '<b>DBH:</b> ', round(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D)) / 10, 1), ' cm<br>'
    )
    sp_ticks <- seq(0, sz, by = 2.5)
    sp_tick_labels <- paste0(sp_ticks, ' m')
    p <- plotly::plot_ly(
      x = sp_data[[x_col]],
      y = sp_data[[y_col]],
      type = 'scatter',
      mode = 'markers+text',
      marker = list(
        color = pt_colors,
        size = pt_sizes,
        line = list(color = 'black', width = 0.8),
        symbol = 'circle'
      ),
      text = as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']]),
      textposition = 'middle center',
      textfont = list(size = 8, color = 'black'),
      hovertext = hover,
      hoverinfo = 'text',
      customdata = tag_ids,
      showlegend = FALSE

        xaxis = list(title = list(text = 'X (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), scaleanchor = 'y', scaleratio = 1, showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),

        shapes = list(list(type = 'rect', x0 = 0, x1 = sz, y0 = 0, y1 = sz, line = list(color = 'darkolivegreen', width = 2), fillcolor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', layer = 'below')),
        plot_bgcolor = 'white',
        paper_bgcolor = 'white',
        margin = list(l = 5, r = 10, t = 60, b = 30)
      ) %>%
      plotly::config(displaylogo = FALSE, responsive = TRUE, displayModeBar = TRUE, modeBarButtonsToRemove = c('lasso2d', 'select2d'), toImageButtonOptions = list(format = 'png', scale = 2)) %>%
      htmlwidgets::onRender(
        'function(el) {
          el.on("plotly_click", function(d) {
            if (!d.points || !d.points.length) return;

            if (a) a.scrollIntoView({behavior: "smooth", block: "center"});
          });
```

### Subparcela 87 {#subplot-87 .unlisted .unnumbered}

```{r subplot-87, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
sp_data <- params$subplots_list[[87]]$data
if (knitr::is_html_output() && !is.null(params$subplots_list[[87]]$data)) {
  if (nrow(sp_data) == 0L) {
    if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[87]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[87]]$plot)
  } else {
    x_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'x10' else 'X'
    y_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'y10' else 'Y'
    sz <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 10 else params$subplot_size
    status_vec <- if ('Status' %in% names(sp_data)) as.integer(sp_data$Status) else rep(NA_integer_, nrow(sp_data))
    diam_vec <- if ('diameter' %in% names(sp_data)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$diameter)) else suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D) / 10)
    diam_vec[!is.finite(diam_vec)] <- 0
    pt_colors <- dplyr::case_when(
      status_vec == 1L ~ 'gray80',
      status_vec == 2L ~ '#EF4444',
      status_vec == 3L ~ 'gold',
      TRUE ~ 'gray80'
    )
    pt_sizes <- pmax(1 + diam_vec * 1.5, 6)
    tag_ids <- gsub('[^A-Za-z0-9-]', '', trimws(as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']])))
    hover <- paste0(
      '<b>Tag:</b> ', sp_data[['New Tag No']], '<br>',
      '<b>Species:</b> ', sp_data[['Original determination']], '<br>',
      '<b>DBH:</b> ', round(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D)) / 10, 1), ' cm<br>'
    )
    sp_ticks <- seq(0, sz, by = 2.5)
    sp_tick_labels <- paste0(sp_ticks, ' m')
    p <- plotly::plot_ly(
      x = sp_data[[x_col]],
      y = sp_data[[y_col]],
      type = 'scatter',
      mode = 'markers+text',
      marker = list(
        color = pt_colors,
        size = pt_sizes,
        line = list(color = 'black', width = 0.8),
        symbol = 'circle'
      ),
      text = as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']]),
      textposition = 'middle center',
      textfont = list(size = 8, color = 'black'),
      hovertext = hover,
      hoverinfo = 'text',
      customdata = tag_ids,
      showlegend = FALSE
    ) %>%
      plotly::layout(
        xaxis = list(title = list(text = 'X (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), scaleanchor = 'y', scaleratio = 1, showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        yaxis = list(title = list(text = 'Y (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        shapes = list(list(type = 'rect', x0 = 0, x1 = sz, y0 = 0, y1 = sz, line = list(color = 'darkolivegreen', width = 2), fillcolor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', layer = 'below')),
        plot_bgcolor = 'white',
        paper_bgcolor = 'white',
        margin = list(l = 5, r = 10, t = 60, b = 30)
      ) %>%
      plotly::config(displaylogo = FALSE, responsive = TRUE, displayModeBar = TRUE, modeBarButtonsToRemove = c('lasso2d', 'select2d'), toImageButtonOptions = list(format = 'png', scale = 2)) %>%
      htmlwidgets::onRender(
        'function(el) {
          el.on("plotly_click", function(d) {
            if (!d.points || !d.points.length) return;
            var t = d.points[0].customdata;
            if (!t) return;
            var a = document.getElementById("checklist-tag-" + t);
            if (a) a.scrollIntoView({behavior: "smooth", block: "center"});
          });
        }'
      )
    p
  }
} else {
  if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[87]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[87]]$plot)
}
```

```{r subplot-88, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
        shapes = list(list(type = 'rect', x0 = 0, x1 = sz, y0 = 0, y1 = sz, line = list(color = 'darkolivegreen', width = 2), fillcolor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', layer = 'below')),
```

### Subparcela 91 {#subplot-91 .unlisted .unnumbered}

```{r subplot-91, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
sp_data <- params$subplots_list[[91]]$data
if (knitr::is_html_output() && !is.null(params$subplots_list[[91]]$data)) {
  if (nrow(sp_data) == 0L) {
    if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[91]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[91]]$plot)
  } else {
    x_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'x10' else 'X'
    y_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'y10' else 'Y'
    sz <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 10 else params$subplot_size
    status_vec <- if ('Status' %in% names(sp_data)) as.integer(sp_data$Status) else rep(NA_integer_, nrow(sp_data))
    diam_vec <- if ('diameter' %in% names(sp_data)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$diameter)) else suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D) / 10)
    diam_vec[!is.finite(diam_vec)] <- 0
    pt_colors <- dplyr::case_when(
      status_vec == 1L ~ 'gray80',
      status_vec == 2L ~ '#EF4444',
      status_vec == 3L ~ 'gold',
      TRUE ~ 'gray80'
    )
    pt_sizes <- pmax(1 + diam_vec * 1.5, 6)
    tag_ids <- gsub('[^A-Za-z0-9-]', '', trimws(as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']])))
    hover <- paste0(
      '<b>Tag:</b> ', sp_data[['New Tag No']], '<br>',
      '<b>Species:</b> ', sp_data[['Original determination']], '<br>',
      '<b>DBH:</b> ', round(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D)) / 10, 1), ' cm<br>'
    )
    sp_ticks <- seq(0, sz, by = 2.5)
    sp_tick_labels <- paste0(sp_ticks, ' m')
    p <- plotly::plot_ly(
      x = sp_data[[x_col]],
      y = sp_data[[y_col]],
      type = 'scatter',
      mode = 'markers+text',
      marker = list(
        color = pt_colors,
        size = pt_sizes,
        line = list(color = 'black', width = 0.8),
        symbol = 'circle'
      ),
      text = as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']]),
      textposition = 'middle center',
      textfont = list(size = 8, color = 'black'),
      hovertext = hover,
      hoverinfo = 'text',
      customdata = tag_ids,
      showlegend = FALSE
    ) %>%
      plotly::layout(
        xaxis = list(title = list(text = 'X (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), scaleanchor = 'y', scaleratio = 1, showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        yaxis = list(title = list(text = 'Y (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        shapes = list(list(type = 'rect', x0 = 0, x1 = sz, y0 = 0, y1 = sz, line = list(color = 'darkolivegreen', width = 2), fillcolor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', layer = 'below')),
        plot_bgcolor = 'white',
        paper_bgcolor = 'white',
        margin = list(l = 5, r = 10, t = 60, b = 30)
      ) %>%
      plotly::config(displaylogo = FALSE, responsive = TRUE, displayModeBar = TRUE, modeBarButtonsToRemove = c('lasso2d', 'select2d'), toImageButtonOptions = list(format = 'png', scale = 2)) %>%
      htmlwidgets::onRender(
        'function(el) {
          el.on("plotly_click", function(d) {
            if (!d.points || !d.points.length) return;
            var t = d.points[0].customdata;
            if (!t) return;
            var a = document.getElementById("checklist-tag-" + t);
            if (a) a.scrollIntoView({behavior: "smooth", block: "center"});
          });
        }'
      )
    p
  }
} else {
  if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[91]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[91]]$plot)
}
```

### Subparcela 95 {#subplot-95 .unlisted .unnumbered}

```{r subplot-95, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
sp_data <- params$subplots_list[[95]]$data
if (knitr::is_html_output() && !is.null(params$subplots_list[[95]]$data)) {
  if (nrow(sp_data) == 0L) {
    if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[95]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[95]]$plot)
  } else {
    x_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'x10' else 'X'
    y_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'y10' else 'Y'
    sz <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 10 else params$subplot_size
    status_vec <- if ('Status' %in% names(sp_data)) as.integer(sp_data$Status) else rep(NA_integer_, nrow(sp_data))
    diam_vec <- if ('diameter' %in% names(sp_data)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$diameter)) else suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D) / 10)
    diam_vec[!is.finite(diam_vec)] <- 0
    pt_colors <- dplyr::case_when(
      status_vec == 1L ~ 'gray80',
      status_vec == 2L ~ '#EF4444',
      status_vec == 3L ~ 'gold',
      TRUE ~ 'gray80'
    )
    pt_sizes <- pmax(1 + diam_vec * 1.5, 6)
    tag_ids <- gsub('[^A-Za-z0-9-]', '', trimws(as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']])))
    hover <- paste0(
      '<b>Tag:</b> ', sp_data[['New Tag No']], '<br>',
      '<b>Species:</b> ', sp_data[['Original determination']], '<br>',
      '<b>DBH:</b> ', round(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D)) / 10, 1), ' cm<br>'
    )
    sp_ticks <- seq(0, sz, by = 2.5)
    sp_tick_labels <- paste0(sp_ticks, ' m')
    p <- plotly::plot_ly(
      x = sp_data[[x_col]],
      y = sp_data[[y_col]],
      type = 'scatter',
      mode = 'markers+text',
      marker = list(
        color = pt_colors,
        size = pt_sizes,
        line = list(color = 'black', width = 0.8),
        symbol = 'circle'
      ),
      text = as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']]),
      textposition = 'middle center',
      textfont = list(size = 8, color = 'black'),
      hovertext = hover,
      hoverinfo = 'text',
      customdata = tag_ids,
      showlegend = FALSE
    ) %>%
      plotly::layout(
        xaxis = list(title = list(text = 'X (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), scaleanchor = 'y', scaleratio = 1, showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        yaxis = list(title = list(text = 'Y (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        shapes = list(list(type = 'rect', x0 = 0, x1 = sz, y0 = 0, y1 = sz, line = list(color = 'darkolivegreen', width = 2), fillcolor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', layer = 'below')),
        plot_bgcolor = 'white',
        paper_bgcolor = 'white',
        margin = list(l = 5, r = 10, t = 60, b = 30)
      ) %>%
      plotly::config(displaylogo = FALSE, responsive = TRUE, displayModeBar = TRUE, modeBarButtonsToRemove = c('lasso2d', 'select2d'), toImageButtonOptions = list(format = 'png', scale = 2)) %>%
      htmlwidgets::onRender(
        'function(el) {
          el.on("plotly_click", function(d) {
            if (!d.points || !d.points.length) return;
            var t = d.points[0].customdata;
            if (!t) return;
            var a = document.getElementById("checklist-tag-" + t);
            if (a) a.scrollIntoView({behavior: "smooth", block: "center"});
          });
        }'
      )
    p
  }
} else {
  if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[95]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[95]]$plot)
}
```

### Subparcela 99 {#subplot-99 .unlisted .unnumbered}

```{r subplot-99, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
sp_data <- params$subplots_list[[99]]$data
if (knitr::is_html_output() && !is.null(params$subplots_list[[99]]$data)) {
  if (nrow(sp_data) == 0L) {
    if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[99]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[99]]$plot)
  } else {
    x_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'x10' else 'X'
    y_col <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 'y10' else 'Y'
    sz <- if ('x10' %in% names(sp_data)) 10 else params$subplot_size
    status_vec <- if ('Status' %in% names(sp_data)) as.integer(sp_data$Status) else rep(NA_integer_, nrow(sp_data))
    diam_vec <- if ('diameter' %in% names(sp_data)) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$diameter)) else suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D) / 10)
    diam_vec[!is.finite(diam_vec)] <- 0
    pt_colors <- dplyr::case_when(
      status_vec == 1L ~ 'gray80',
      status_vec == 2L ~ '#EF4444',
      status_vec == 3L ~ 'gold',
      TRUE ~ 'gray80'
    )
    pt_sizes <- pmax(1 + diam_vec * 1.5, 6)
    tag_ids <- gsub('[^A-Za-z0-9-]', '', trimws(as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']])))
    hover <- paste0(
      '<b>Tag:</b> ', sp_data[['New Tag No']], '<br>',
      '<b>Species:</b> ', sp_data[['Original determination']], '<br>',
      '<b>DBH:</b> ', round(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sp_data$D)) / 10, 1), ' cm<br>'
    )
    sp_ticks <- seq(0, sz, by = 2.5)
    sp_tick_labels <- paste0(sp_ticks, ' m')
    p <- plotly::plot_ly(
      x = sp_data[[x_col]],
      y = sp_data[[y_col]],
      type = 'scatter',
      mode = 'markers+text',
      marker = list(
        color = pt_colors,
        size = pt_sizes,
        line = list(color = 'black', width = 0.8),
        symbol = 'circle'
      ),
      text = as.character(sp_data[['New Tag No']]),
      textposition = 'middle center',
      textfont = list(size = 8, color = 'black'),
      hovertext = hover,
      hoverinfo = 'text',
      customdata = tag_ids,
      showlegend = FALSE
    ) %>%
      plotly::layout(
        xaxis = list(title = list(text = 'X (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), scaleanchor = 'y', scaleratio = 1, showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        yaxis = list(title = list(text = 'Y (m)', standoff = 5), range = c(-0.5, sz + 0.5), showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = 'gray90', zeroline = FALSE, tickmode = 'array', tickvals = sp_ticks, ticktext = sp_tick_labels),
        shapes = list(list(type = 'rect', x0 = 0, x1 = sz, y0 = 0, y1 = sz, line = list(color = 'darkolivegreen', width = 2), fillcolor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0)', layer = 'below')),
        plot_bgcolor = 'white',
        paper_bgcolor = 'white',
        margin = list(l = 5, r = 10, t = 60, b = 30)
      ) %>%
      plotly::config(displaylogo = FALSE, responsive = TRUE, displayModeBar = TRUE, modeBarButtonsToRemove = c('lasso2d', 'select2d'), toImageButtonOptions = list(format = 'png', scale = 2)) %>%
      htmlwidgets::onRender(
        'function(el) {
          el.on("plotly_click", function(d) {
            if (!d.points || !d.points.length) return;
            var t = d.points[0].customdata;
            if (!t) return;
            var a = document.getElementById("checklist-tag-" + t);
            if (a) a.scrollIntoView({behavior: "smooth", block: "center"});
          });
        }'
      )
    p
  }
} else {
  if (!is.null(params$subplots_list[[99]]$plot)) print(params$subplots_list[[99]]$plot)
}
```

## Lista de Espécies {#checklist}

```{r checklist, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
cat('\n')
for (fam in unique(spec_df$Family)) {
  cat('\n\n### ', fam, '\n\n', sep = '')
  fam_df <- spec_df %>% filter(Family == fam)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(fam_df))) {
    sp <- fam_df$Species_fmt[i]
    tag_vec <- fam_df$tag_vec[[i]]
    tag_vec <- as.character(tag_vec)
    tag_vec <- trimws(tag_vec)
    tag_vec <- tag_vec[!is.na(tag_vec) & nzchar(tag_vec)]
    if (length(tag_vec) == 0) next
    ids <- safe_id(tag_vec)
    t2s_df <- params$tag_to_subplot
    tag_df <- data.frame(tag = tag_vec, id = ids, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    is_monitora <- tolower(trimws(as.character(params$input_type))) == 'monitora'
    tag_df <- merge(tag_df, t2s_df, by.x = 'tag', by.y = 'New Tag No', all.x = TRUE, sort = FALSE)
    if (is_monitora) {
      tag_df$target_idx <- ifelse(!is.na(tag_df$subplot_index), tag_df$subplot_index, safe_num(tag_df$T1))
      has_fields <- !is.na(tag_df$subunit_letter) & !is.na(tag_df$T2)
      tag_df$subplot_code <- ifelse(has_fields, paste0(tag_df$subunit_letter, tag_df$T2), paste0('S', tag_df$target_idx))
      o <- order(tag_df$target_idx, safe_num(tag_df$tag))
      tag_df <- tag_df[o, , drop = FALSE]
      tag_df$anchor_id <- gsub('[^A-Za-z0-9-]', '', tag_df$tag)
      if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
        tag_links <- paste(sprintf('<span id="checklist-tag-%s"></span>[%s → %s](#subplot-%s)', tag_df$anchor_id, tag_df$tag, tag_df$subplot_code, tag_df$target_idx), collapse = ' | ')
      } else {
        tag_links <- paste(sprintf('[ %s → %s ](#subplot-%s)', tag_df$tag, tag_df$subplot_code, tag_df$target_idx), collapse = ' | ')
      }
    } else {
      tag_df$target_idx <- safe_num(tag_df$T1)
      o <- order(tag_df$target_idx, safe_num(tag_df$tag))
      tag_df <- tag_df[o, , drop = FALSE]
      tag_df$anchor_id <- gsub('[^A-Za-z0-9-]', '', tag_df$tag)
      if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
        tag_links <- paste(sprintf('<span id="checklist-tag-%s"></span>[%s - S%s](#subplot-%s)', tag_df$anchor_id, tag_df$tag, tag_df$target_idx, tag_df$target_idx), collapse = ' | ')
      } else {
        tag_links <- paste(sprintf('[ %s - S%s ](#subplot-%s)', tag_df$tag, tag_df$target_idx, tag_df$target_idx), collapse = ' | ')
      }
    }
    cat('* ', sp, ' : ', tag_links, '\n', sep = '')
  }
}
```

```{r force-plotly-resize, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
<script>
```
